secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co). Find it in your Supabase dashboard under Project Settings > API. Required for login and all data.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable/anon public key from Project Settings > API > Project API keys. Required for auth and data access (RLS-protected). VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is used as a fallback if this is unset.

secrets.name: VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_PLATFORM_KEY
secrets.description: Optional Google Maps Platform API key for the property map view. Leave blank to disable maps.

secrets.name: VITE_POSTHOG_KEY
secrets.description: Optional PostHog project key for error monitoring/analytics. Leave blank to disable PostHog.
